The Moisture Problem

Ascending moisture is one of the most common problems in Portuguese homes and businesses, especially in older buildings. Water rises through walls by capillary action, causing structural damage, health problems, and loss of property value.

Warning signs:

Dark stains on walls
Mold and dampness smell
Peeling paint
Health issues (allergies, asthma)
Structural degradation
High energy costs

Our Solution

We combine the DRYMAT system (ascending moisture elimination via electromagnetic frequency) with ClimateCoating (ceramic thermal coating) for a complete and lasting solution.

DRYMAT

Austrian electromagnetic frequency system that reverses capillary water movement in walls. No construction, no demolition.

ClimateCoating

Ceramic coating that provides thermal insulation and prevents condensation. Reduces energy costs by up to 30%.

Types of wall moisture

Not all moisture is the same. Correct identification is essential to choose the right treatment. We address the three most common types in Portugal:

Ascending moisture

Rises from the ground by capillary action. Stains up to 1.5m, saltpeter, peeling paint. Most common in old houses and seaside buildings. Solved by Drymat.

Condensation

Water vapor condensing on cold walls, especially in winter. Dark stains in corners, ceilings and behind furniture. Solved with ClimateCoating, which regulates indoor humidity to around 55%.

Infiltrations

Water entering from outside through cracks, roofs or facades. Solved with ClimateCoating ThermoProtect on the facade, creating a waterproof and breathable membrane.

How the treatment works (step by step)

  1. 1

    Free diagnosis

    On-site visit, wall moisture measurement and problem identification. We deliver a tailored plan and quote, no commitment.

  2. 2

    Drymat installation

    A few hours, no construction. The device is mounted on a wall and connected to power. No wires across rooms, no demolition.

  3. 3

    Progressive drying

    Over 2 to 6 months, Drymat reverses capillary action. We monitor progress with measurements.

  4. 4

    ClimateCoating application (optional)

    Once the wall is dry, ClimateCoating is applied as interior paint to regulate humidity and reinforce thermal insulation.

  5. 5

    Follow-up and warranty

    10-year Drymat warranty and 15-year ClimateCoating warranty. If moisture returns, we return.

FAQ

What is ascending moisture?

It is water rising through walls from the ground, by capillary action. It is the most difficult type of moisture to treat and the most common in older buildings or coastal areas.

How do I know if I have ascending moisture and not condensation?

Ascending moisture appears in the lower part of walls (up to about 1.5 metres), with stains, saltpeter, peeling paint and mold smell. Condensation appears in corners and ceilings, near windows, and usually disappears with proper ventilation.

How long does it take to eliminate wall moisture?

In 2 to 6 months you will see an 80 to 100% reduction. Drymat acts continuously and the wall dries progressively.

Does Drymat work in old buildings under rehabilitation?

Yes, it is especially effective in historic and rehabilitation buildings, with no demolition or chemical injections that could damage the structure.

Is construction work needed?

No. The Drymat system is installed in a few hours without demolition. ClimateCoating is then applied like a normal paint.

How do I eliminate saltpeter and mold smell?

Saltpeter and mold smell are caused by moisture. Once moisture is eliminated, both disappear within a few months.

What is the warranty?

The Drymat system has a 10-year warranty. ClimateCoating has a warranty of over 15 years.

Do you serve all of Portugal?

Yes. We are based in the Algarve and operate nationwide, including mainland Portugal, Madeira and the Azores.
